name: AEROSPACE Earbuds Black
description: Black curved earpieces frame silver star-shaped details in the most contrasting colourway of AEROSPACE.
fullDescription: AEROSPACE Black brings the visual language of jewellery into earbud design. Dark curved earpieces act as a backdrop for pointed silver stars and rectangular decorative accents, making the contrast between the two finishes part of the design. The sculptural front is intended to remain visible as part of an outfit. Choose Black, Silver or White through the colour selector to explore the other AEROSPACE colourways.
